query: I have a 68‑year‑old male post‑op ICU patient. Among male post‑op ICU patients aged 63–73 in the top quartile of instability, what is the 95th‑percentile instability score and how do fever (>38.5°C), SpO2<90%, RR>20 episodes, ICU LOS, and in‑hospital mortality compare to other post‑op patients?
final_sql:
WITH InstabilityScore AS (
  SELECT
    ic.subject_id,
    ic.hadm_id,
    ic.stay_id,
    -- Calculate instability score based on vital signs
    (
      CASE WHEN ce.itemid = 220177 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + -- Heart Rate
